exposure: Nasopharyngeal aspirate (NA) interleukin 6 (IL6) levels at 7 days of life
Lung Ultrasound (LUS) scores at 7 days of life
cohort: The study included 42 preterm infants born before 30 weeks of gestation.
finding: Both nasopharyngeal aspirate IL-6 levels and lung ultrasound scores at 7 days of life independently predicted bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) in preterm infants, with a combined model including birth weight and days of mechanical ventilation showing strong predictive capability.
